title: Add preflight check: verify .agent/prd/PRD.md and .agent/tasks.json exist
description: At the start of the feature command, check that both PRD.md and tasks.json exist. If either is missing, print a clear error and suggest running 'rocket init'.
acceptanceCriteria: Running rocket feature without .agent/prd/PRD.md prints error mentioning 'rocket init'
Running rocket feature without .agent/tasks.json prints error mentioning 'rocket init'
Process exits with code 1 when either file is missing
No TUI renders before the check completes

steps.description: Add file existence checks at start of featureCommand
steps.details: const agentDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.agent'); const prdPath = path.join(agentDir, 'prd', 'PRD.md'); const tasksPath = path.join(agentDir, 'tasks.json'); if (!await fs.pathExists(prdPath)) { console.error('Missing .agent/prd/PRD.md. Run rocket init to set up the .agent/ structure.'); process.exit(1) } if (!await fs.pathExists(tasksPath)) { console.error('Missing .agent/tasks.json. Run rocket init first.'); process.exit(1) }
Run rocket feature in a directory with only tasks.json (no PRD.md) and verify the error message. Repeat for missing tasks.json.
